# Cash Denomination Calculator & Drawer Reconciler

> A lightweight, client-side financial utility for retail cashiers, accountants, and bank tellers to tally banknote and coin denominations, deduct opening register floats, and generate audit slips in real-time.

## Project Overview

- **Canonical URL**: https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/cashdenominationcalculator/
- **Author**: Ahmed Elazab
- **Primary Technology**: Native JavaScript (Client-side arithmetic, no external dependencies)
- **Supported Currencies**: USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), EGP (E£), SAR (ر.س), AED (د.إ), INR (₹), CAD (C$), and AUD (A$).

## Core Features & Financial Logic

1. **Denomination-Specific Breakdown**:
   - Real-time multiplication of physical bill and coin counts by circulating face values.
   - Dynamic currency selector that swaps notes and coins according to official central bank issuance.

2. **Opening Float & Net Deposit Calculation**:
   - Separates starting base cash (the opening float) from gross drawer cash.
   - Computes the exact net bank deposit amount to identify drawer overages and shortages against POS records.

3. **Number-to-Words Generation**:
   - Converts monetary figures into formal English words (e.g., "One Thousand, Four Hundred and Fifty Dollars and Twenty Cents Only") for checks, deposit slips, and receipt vouchers.

4. **Reporting & Audit Tools**:
   - One-click clipboard export formatting an itemized summary suitable for shift logs and emails.
   - Dedicated print stylesheet (`@media print`) rendering clean, paper-ready cash drop slips with signature lines.

## Technical Specifications

- **Performance**: 100% Lighthouse score, zero external Google Fonts (using system font stack), zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.000).
- **Privacy**: 100% client-side memory execution; no financial numbers, drawer balances, or currency tallies are transmitted to any server.
- **Accessibility**: Full WCAG AAA color contrast compliance, sequentially descending heading hierarchy, and accessible form inputs.
